I will not tolerate people who target our communities and hurt our loved ones and think they will not be held accountable. Not in Maryland.

Thirteen different agencies came together and busted a drug-trafficking organization affiliated with a cartel that trafficked narcotics across the region. Thank you to everyone and every agency who played a part in the largest cocaine seizure in the history of Wicomico County.

These arrests keep our streets safe from those who have been terrorizing our com

Marylanders, tax season’s almost over!

We’ve expanded credits and benefits to put money back into the pockets of Maryland families, so be sure to check your eligibility for these state and federal benefits when you file your taxes:

💰 Maryland Earned Income Tax Credit: Marylanders could get up to $4,000 back on their state tax return.

🧑‍🧒 Maryland Child Tax Credit: Eligible families with children can receive a $500 credit per child to help with the cost of raising children.

🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Section 530A

Across the Baltimore region, there are over 130 acres of state-owned land ready for development, ready to support nearly 5,000 new homes, and ready to generate almost $1.4 billion in state and local tax revenue. 

Together with @MayorBMScott, our General Assembly partners, and @MarylandDOT, we’re going to deliver safer, reliable, cheaper transit options and build housing connected to transit, community, and opportunity.

For far too long, some communities have been asked to accept being underestimated and undervalued.

We’ve rejected that. At Edmondson Village, we're helping to deliver health care, fresh food, support for seniors, and new investments in child care so that we can together rewrite a narrative about a city and a community that have been historically ignored.

From Day One, our administration chose to invest in the people of Baltimore – because for this to be Maryland’s decade, it must be Baltimore’
Spring has sprung here in Annapolis! 💐

As families, friends, and communities in Maryland and around the world gather today to celebrate Easter, our hearts are with all who are facing uncertainty, fear, and hardship.

May today's celebrations renew spirits, breathe new hope into the world, and bring much-needed peace to all in Maryland and beyond. 🕊️

After continuous community pushback, court orders, and united work from elected officials, we’re seeing ICE backtrack on this detention warehouse near Hagerstown.

When we contacted DHS in February, we relayed our concerns about this process – including the lack of transparency, federal-local collaboration, or public input from the local community. Thank you so much to each of our General Assembly’s student pages for their hard work and dedication throughout this session.

Led by @OAGMaryland , we’ve joined a coalition of attorneys general across the country challenging President Trump’s UNLAWFUL attempt to interfere with states’ constitutional authority to administer elections.

What the President wants to do has nothing to do with making elections more secure. It is a clear attempt to disenfranchise voters and undermine our democracy.

@SamsungUS opened their very FIRST U.S.-based manufacturing facility right here in Maryland! Life-saving therapies for people around the world are going to be made here in America, while also strengthening our state’s economy. 

Maryland delivers – and we’re not playing for second.
